授業概要
大学院における有機合成化学学習の導入講義として，有機分子の構築法，特に，逆合成解析と選択性（官能基選択性、位置選択性、立体選択性）について論じる．なお，本講義では，適宜，演習を行い講義内容の習得を図る．
本講義は、前半の逆合成解析は新藤が担当し、後半の選択性は國信が担当する。
This introductory lecture for graduate-level synthetic organic chemistry covers methods for constructing organic molecules, withparticular emphasis on retrosynthetic analysis and selectivity (functional group selectivity, regioselectivity, and stereoselectivity).Throughout the course, exercises will be conducted as appropriate to facilitate mastery of the lecture content.
Prof. Shindo will cover theretrosynthetic analysis in the first half of this lecture, while Prof. Kuninobu will cover selectivity in the second half.
